aim_summary.goal: Add a 1.7 millimetre diameter connecting hole and multiple 0.1 millimetre grooves while preserving non-targeted geometry.
aim_summary.expected_outcome: The mounting clevis bracket contains a 1.7 millimetre connecting hole and multiple 0.1 millimetre grooves that support connection, improve grip, and resist slipping without altering unrelated geometry.

operations_plan.summary: Add the requested 1.7 millimetre diameter connecting hole.

steps.description: Drill a 1.7 millimetre diameter hole into SOLID 0; the supporting face and face-local center require clarification.

expected_result.geometry: The final bracket contains a connecting hole with a diameter of 1.7 millimetres at the clarified location and orientation.
expected_result.function: The hole supports connection of the intended model elements.

validation_criteria.description: A connecting hole exists at the clarified location and its cylindrical bore diameter measures 1.7 millimetres.
The connecting hole provides the required connection interface between the intended model elements.
Existing bracket geometry, including F002 and F003, remains unchanged except where the new connecting hole necessarily intersects the body.

operations_plan.summary: Cut multiple grooves with the requested 0.1 millimetre groove dimension into the intended gripping or contact region.

expected_result.function: The grooves increase grip at the intended contact region.
expected_result.behavior: The grooved contact region resists unwanted relative slipping.

validation_criteria.description: Multiple grooves exist on the clarified gripping or contact region, and the clarified groove dimension measures 0.1 millimetre.
